summary: Add durable Webhook and SMTP notifications with console configuration
details: Monitor alerts now recover automatically from continuous valid evidence; ack and manual monitor resolution are removed while durable incident protection remains owned by the source service.
Persist independent notification jobs with bounded retry, per-channel delivery results, configurable warning and critical reminder intervals, and no new-channel historical replay.
Edit the same private notification configuration from a local JSON file or authenticated control-plane forms, with masked credentials and local-worker test delivery.
Monitor snapshots use usdb-node-monitor:v2 for structured notification status; event schema and event database version remain v1.
operator_actions: Upgrade the node kit and services image together using the normal down/activate/setup/up flow, then configure notification channels in the private console or monitor/notifications/config.json.
